title: Orgasm
summary: An orgasm is the peak of sexual pleasure: built-up tension is released, often with rhythmic muscle contractions in the pelvic area and a wave of pleasure, followed by relaxation.
key_points: It can happen during sex or masturbation, and feels different for different people.
Many people with a vulva need clitoral stimulation to reach orgasm.
Sex can be enjoyable without orgasm; pressuring yourself to 'finish' often makes it harder.
answer_guidance: Explain plainly and positively. If asked 'how', stay educational: relaxation, the right kind of stimulation, communication.
